_doc: quiet_high: skills whose High calls are reminders, not safety calls (they are quieted like Normal ones once mastered). allows: a failure of this skill also allows one reminder of these skills. Skill taxonomy (docs/player-profile.md 'Skills and mastery'). Every rule cue carries one skill: `cards` (module.card_id, most specific) win over `cues` (cue key patterns: exact, or a prefix ending in '*'; the longest pattern wins). mastered_after: unprompted successes needed within the last `window` matches (the match in progress counts), with at most `max_failures` failures. A mastered skill is unmastered after `unmaster_failures` failures in the window, or 2 in one match.

skills.label: Spending souls on the death screen
skills.description: Every death is a free shop visit: buy before you respawn so you come back stronger.

skills.label: Spending souls when you are in base
skills.description: Back in base with souls for an item: buy it before you walk out.

skills.label: Spending souls before they pile up
skills.description: Souls in your pocket do nothing and are lost value when you die: shop at the usual tier.

skills.label: Leaving base at full health
skills.description: Healing in base is fast: walk out at full health, not at half.

skills.label: Last hits and farm
skills.description: Secure last hits and denies, and keep your farm at the lobby's pace.

skills.label: Backing off at low health
skills.description: Under a third of your health, break line of sight and heal before you trade again.

skills.label: Staying behind your troopers and out of tower range
skills.description: Fight from behind your own wave; let troopers tank enemy structures.

skills.label: Backing off to secure haunted souls
skills.description: Unsecured souls are lost if you die: step back until they secure.

skills.label: Walking out with a teammate after respawning
skills.description: After a respawn, leave base with the next teammate instead of walking into the enemy alone.

skills.label: Catching waves before roaming
skills.description: A wave reaching our side is free souls and safety: catch it before camps or roaming.

skills.label: Farming camps between waves
skills.description: Take the nearest camp while your wave is pushed, then be back for the next wave.

skills.label: Pushing when enemies are dead
skills.description: Two or more enemies dead is a free push or objective: group and take it.

skills.label: Respecting missing enemies
skills.description: Enemies you cannot see may be next to you: don't push past your wave when several are missing.

skills.label: Safe zipline travel
skills.description: Ziplines are slow and exposed: drop off before enemies, never ride into a fight low.

skills.label: Soul Urn plays
skills.description: Take the Urn when we have the numbers, walk it straight in, skip it when we are down.

skills.label: Buying counter items
skills.description: Buy against what is actually hurting you (bullet, spirit, crowd control).

skills.label: Joining team fights
skills.description: Rotate to the fight your team takes when your wave is safe.

skills.label: Not fighting outnumbered
skills.description: One against two or more is a lost fight: back off to a teammate or a structure.

skills.label: Taking fights you can win
skills.description: Commit when we have the numbers or an enemy is low; together, not alone.

skills.label: Escaping after a stun or silence
skills.description: Crowd control is the enemy's kill setup: get out the moment it ends; buy against it if it keeps happening.

skills.label: Planning objectives ahead
skills.description: Shove and group 30-45 seconds before the Urn, Midboss and weak structures, with a job for you.

skills.label: Protecting a lead
skills.description: Ahead: take objectives and skip risky fights in their base. Behind: farm safe and defend together.

skills.label: Leaving a lost fight early
skills.description: When your frontliner or two teammates fall, the fight is lost: back out before you are next.

skills.label: Tracking the enemy's dangerous heroes
skills.description: Know where their divers and fed heroes are; fight them only together.

skills.label: Resetting after a won fight
skills.description: A won fight at low health is not a free structure: heal first, then take it together.

skills.label: Positioning against divers
skills.description: Against melee divers and burst, play from max range behind your front line and keep an escape.

skills.label: Defending your base in time
skills.description: Enemies in our base or a structure under attack: go back and defend together.
